action.text: Task: Two optimized builds changed behavior (arithmetic error; complex vs real result). The bug in compiler/unary.py: visit_UnaryOp returns node.operand for both UAdd AND USub, dropping the negation sign for USub. Fix: only simplify for numeric literals (int/float, not bool); UAdd→operand; USub→Constant(negated value). Need to: fix unary.py, read observations (OBS-0001 input, OBS-0002 BUILD-A, OBS-0003 BUILD-B), compare to find changed functions/expressions, write reports/incident.json, run public check.
